useCase: 画像改ざんの検出 through re-saving, quality 操作, and spliced regions with different compression histories
mechanism: 分析します DCT 係数 ヒストグラムs for periodic パターン caused by double quantization. When a JPEG image is decompressed and re-compressed at a different quality, the DCT 係数 exhibit characteristic periodic アーティファクト (combing effect) in their ヒストグラムs that are detectable through frequency 分析.
accuracy: 高 - 82-92% for images with detectable double compression
name: 二重JPEG圧縮検出
source: Lukáš & Fridrich (2003) - Estimation of Primary Quantization Matrix in Double-Compressed JPEG Images, DFRWS
parameters: ブロックサイズ: 8x8 DCT, Quality range: 50-99, Analysis: ヒストグラム periodicity via DFT, Detection 閾値: 適応型
description: 検出します traces of double JPEG圧縮 を分析することで DCT 係数 ヒストグラムs. Tampering often involves re-saving, creating detectable periodic パターン in DCT domain.

references.title: Lukáš, J. & Fridrich, J. (2003). Estimation of Primary Quantization Matrix in Double-Compressed JPEG Images. DFRWS.
Bianchi, T. & Piva, A. (2012). Image Forgery Localization via Block-Grained Analysis of JPEG Artifacts. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• 再保存されたJPEGの検出に非常に信頼性が高い
• 元の圧縮品質を推定可能
• 改ざん領域を特定
• 確立された数学的基盤
limitations:
• Only works on JPEG format images
• Ineffective when both compressions use same quality
• Cannot detect single-compressed AI images
• Requires sufficient image size for 統計的 信頼性
